fields.label: BatFlags
fields.help: 1 when hanging upside-down from a block, 0 when flying.

fields.label: Anger
fields.help: Time left in ticks until the bee's anger ends. If this is zero, it is not angry.

fields.label: Has Nectar
fields.help: Whether it is carrying pollen.

fields.label: Has Stung
fields.help: Whether it has stung a mob or player.

fields.label: Ticks Since Pollination
fields.help: Number of ticks passed since its last pollination.

fields.help: Time left in ticks until the bee can enter a beehive.

fields.help: Used to limit number of crops it can grow.

fields.help: Coordinates of its hive.

fields.help: Stores coordinates of the flower it is circling.

fields.help: If true, then the chicken can naturally despawn.

fields.help: Ticks countdown until the chicken lays its egg, laying at 0. Timer resets to a new random number between 6000 and 12000.

fields.help: The weathered state of the copper golem.

fields.help: Number of ticks until the golem's next weathering state change. (-1 is random 504000 to 552000 ticks, -2 is waxed)

fields.help: Coordinate destination when leading a player to treasure

fields.help: Endermen attack the endermite if this value is 1

fields.help: Experience Amount.

fields.help: Number of times that the orb can be picked up

fields.help: Orbs take damage from fire, lava, falling anvils, and explosions. The orb is destroyed when its health reaches 0.

chestedhorse.label: ChestedHorse
chestedhorse.help: If true the horse has a chest.

explosion_power.label: ExplosionPower
explosion_power.help: The radius of the explosion created by the fireball.

frombucket.label: From Bucket
frombucket.help: Fish placed with buckets do not despawn naturally.

hurtby_j115.label: HurtBy
hurtby_j115.help: Was attacked by player/entity with UUID.

hurtby_j116.help: The UUID of the player that attacked the bee, stored as four ints.

llama_strength.label: Strength
llama_strength.help: Higher numbers more carry capacify and better wolf defence.

spellticks.label: SpellTicks
spellticks.help: Spell cooldown, number of ticks until a spell can be cast.

size.label: Size
size.help: Set size, 0,1,2 are natural, but you can go much larger.

temper.label: Temper
temper.help: Ranges from 0 to 100. Increases with feeding. Higher values make a horse easier to tame.

drownedconversiontime.label: Drowned Conversion Time
drownedconversiontime.help: The number of ticks until converts to a drowned. (default value is -1, when no conversion is under way).

inwatertime.label: InWaterTime
inwatertime.help: The number of ticks has been under water, used to start the drowning conversion. (default value is -1, when no conversion is under way).

spawnreinforcements.label: spawnReinforcements
spawnreinforcements.value: This is an attribute under the attributes tab.

timeinoverworld.label: Time In Overworld
timeinoverworld.help: The number of ticks has has existed in the Overworld, conversion happens at 300
